kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننذئف (form VII)
# نَنْذَئِفُ (nanḏaʔifu) /nan.ða.ʔi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# نَنْذَئِفَ (nanḏaʔifa) /nan.ða.ʔi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# نَنْذَئِفْ (nanḏaʔif) /nan.ða.ʔif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
